name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya Sharma is a name whispered with respect in aviation circles. After earning her undergraduate degree, she quickly rose through the ranks to become a seasoned commercial pilot, known for her calm demeanor and meticulous attention to detail. While she has dedicated her life to the skies, Priya harbors a deep love for motorsport, a passion sparked by her late father, a former rally driver. Although not directly involved in racing herself, she often attends high-profile events and quietly supports young, promising talents.

Reserved and idealistic, Priya is a generous soul who believes in giving back. She's known to be impatient with incompetence but fiercely loyal to those who earn her respect. Her aloofness can sometimes be misinterpreted as arrogance, but those who break through her shell discover a warm and engaging individual with a sharp wit and a keen interest in the world around her. A racing driver might cross paths with her at a charity event she sponsors, often related to motorsport safety or supporting young drivers from underprivileged backgrounds.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly tied back in a low bun
physical.description: Priya has a commanding presence, with a strong jawline and piercing eyes. Her face bears the subtle lines of someone who has seen the world and carries herself with quiet confidence.

connectionToMotorsport: Priya is a silent investor in a junior racing team and a patron of motorsport safety initiatives. She attends several major races each year and keeps a close watch on emerging talents.
meetingContext: You might meet Priya at a pre-race gala or charity event, possibly connected to motorsport safety or driver development programs. She may also be introduced to you through one of your engineers or team managers who are already aware of her interest in motorsport.
